You are the **BUILDER** for **COMMIT 5** — the last commit in this sequence. Five commits have landed and been independently verified, and the developer's live-page acceptance check on the previous one has passed. Repo: `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa` @ `b48024f`. **Working tree completely clean.** Keep it that way except for your files. # Spec `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/.claude/jobs/723a905e/tmp/commit5-spec.md` — verified slice of the live plan (sha-stamped; every line proved present). Note **6a and 6c are CUT**. Only **6b** is in scope: extract the header render function into a partial, and story it. # What 6b is `renderStaticProductHeader` currently lives inline in `pages/product-detail/index.tsx`. Extract it to `pages/product-detail/partials/staticProductHeader.tsx` and give it three stories. **The directory does not exist yet** — you create it. **The filename is camelCase, deliberately.** The plan originally said `static-product-header.tsx` citing "base convention is kebab-case". That was corrected: `conventions.md` scopes kebab-case to *override files mirroring a base Salesforce file*, and this partial mirrors nothing (base's `partials/` holds only `information-accordion.jsx`). Every one of the 10 `ui-kits` directories PR #59 created is camelCase, no Zimmermann-authored kebab-case file exists anywhere in `overrides/`, and the decisive sibling precedent is two files away: `pages/product-detail/productInfo.ts`. **The `partials/` directory name itself stays as-is** — that one does mirror base. # It is NOT a pure move — resolve the closure MEASURED: `renderStaticProductHeader` calls `formatPrice` (`index.tsx:719-720`), which closes over `formatNumber` from `useIntl()` (`:162`). **Also MEASURED, and it changes the shape of the fix:** `formatPrice` is used at **two** sites — `:740` inside the header function, and `:793` for `staticInfo`, which feeds the meta block and stays on the page. **So extraction does not remove `formatPrice`, `formatNumber` or `useIntl` from the page.** Do not delete them. Two ways to resolve it, your call — state which and why: - **Pass the formatter in** as a prop. Keeps the partial a pure function of its inputs; the story must then supply a formatter. - **Call `useIntl()` inside** the partial. Makes it a real component, so it can hold hooks; the story needs no formatter because `.storybook/preview.tsx` already supplies an `IntlProvider`. Note `useIntl()` **throws** without one, so anything rendering it must be wrapped — that is a real constraint, not a preference. If you make it a component, `renderHeader` still expects a function returning a ReactNode, so the call site becomes something like `renderHeader={(p) => }`. Keep the prop contract identical either way. # Three stories, `Commerce/` title Per the spec: 1. **full product** — everything renders 2. **`product` absent, `name` present** — the `headerProduct ?? { name }` path, which also shows the price collapsing 3. **neither** — the PDP's loading state on every page load, and where D17's skeleton reserve lives. `components.md` names `Loading` as its first example of a meaningful state. # Do NOT add a test The spec adds no test file, and G2 must stay at **364**. **Specifically: do not add the `zimmProductContent` price-identity test a previous review suggested.** I checked it and it would not protect what it claims to. It would assert that React reuses a DOM node when only a prop changes — which React guarantees, so it passes whether or not the page sets `keepPreviousData: true`. The dependency actually being protected is that the *page* keeps `product` defined so `info` never goes null and the component never unmounts; a component-level test cannot see the page's query config. `testing.md` also explicitly lists "don't test the framework" as a non-goal. The comment already at `index.tsx`'s `keepPreviousData` is the honest protection. Leave it at that. # Gates | Gate | Required | Note | |---|---|---| | G1 `npx tsc --noEmit` | **0** | | | G2 `npx vitest run` | **364 / 24** | no new tests | | G3 `npm run lint` | **17 err / 15 warn** | **the load-bearing gate.** Extraction moves imports between files. **Any warning increase means an import was left behind unused in the page** — and remember `formatPrice`/`formatNumber`/`useIntl` all stay, because `staticInfo` still needs them | | G4 storybook | **105 / 24** | 3 new stories in 1 new file, from 102/23. **REBUILD REQUIRED.** `.storybook/preview.tsx` sets `a11y: { test: 'error' }`, so all 105 are axe assertions — your three must pass | | G5 `npm run audit:tokens` | **14 unack / 22 ack** | `pages/**` is outside `SCAN_ROOTS`, so this is structurally immovable | **Never run `test-storybook` bare** — its default URL is `127.0.0.1:6006`, where a stale server (PID 21958, running since Friday) serves a broken index and yields 100% timeouts. Bind port 0 to get a free port, serve `storybook-static` with `python3 -m http.server`, and pass `--url`. Read counts, not exit codes: G3 and G5 both exit 1 at a healthy baseline. # Two behavioural constraints that must survive - **`headingLevel="h2"`** — the page already emits a screen-reader-only `

Product Details

`, and the base header this replaced rendered the name as an `h2`. Changing the outline is SEO's call, not a side effect of an extraction. - **The function must stay pure of side effects** — it is called **twice per render** (base renders the header twice behind responsive `display` arrays). # Do NOT - Open any file outside `pages/product-detail/`. - Commit, stage, stash, or touch any git ref. - Append args to `npm run lint`. `lint:fix` / `pwa-kit-dev format` forbidden. - Run `npm start`. Install packages. Touch Tier 1 or test config. - Change any rendered output. This is an extraction: the DOM before and after must be identical. **Prove that**, don't assert it. Restore: `git checkout HEAD -- `. # Standing rules — every one earned in this sequence - **Locate by content; report `brief says :N, found at :M`.** Every number in this plan has drifted at least once. - **Mutation-prove before claiming.** Prove tsc checks a new file before trusting a clean run — and use an **undeclared identifier**, not a bad Chakra token: a typo'd responsive key type-checks clean. - **Name mutation backups by full-path slug, never `basename`** — a `basename` collision destroyed a file earlier in this sequence. - **Every claim in a comment must be true of observable state.** Three commits were blocked on false comments, and two of those claims came from me. - **Instruction refusal authorised** — report `REFUSED: — — `. Fired three times, correct every time. - **Treat every claim in this brief as CLAIMED.** Eleven of my assertions have been caught wrong across this loop. # Report back 1. The closure decision (prop vs `useIntl()` inside) and why. 2. Each file with its final path, and the re-location table for every cited line. 3. **Your proof the rendered DOM is unchanged** by the extraction. 4. The three stories, and confirmation each passes axe. 5. The five gate numbers, G3's warning count and G5's acknowledged count explicit, plus confirmation you rebuilt Storybook and served it on a free port you obtained by binding port 0. 6. `git diff --stat` plus `git status --short`. 7. Anything noticed and not fixed. Any `REFUSED:`.
